scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/schemas build && bun run --cwd packages/sdk build && bun run --cwd packages/scoring build && bun run --cwd apps/site build && bun run --cwd apps/dashboard build
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/sdk verify:package
scripts.postinstall: bun run --cwd packages/schemas build && bun run --cwd packages/sdk build && bun run --cwd packages/scoring build
scripts.prepare:testnet-deployment: make -C packages/claim-cell-script build && mkdir -p deployments/migrations && cd deployments && ckb-cli --url https://testnet.ckbapp.dev --output-format json deploy gen-txs --deployment-config testnet.toml --migration-dir migrations --fee-rate 1200 --from-address ckt1qyqqm5lgalzn8485x7q0h98g0janaae8juvq9j3fte --info-file info.json
scripts.test: bun test --pass-with-no-tests apps/dashboard/src apps/dashboard/server apps/dashboard/api apps/site/src packages/schemas/src packages/scoring/src packages/sdk/src packages/ui/src deployments
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/site/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.server.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/scoring/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p deployments/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:testnet-deployment: make -C packages/claim-cell-script build && bun run deployments/verify.ts
scripts.view:testnet-deployment: cd deployments && ckb-cli --url https://testnet.ckbapp.dev deploy explain-txs --info-file info.json
